primary_readout: H1 absolute squared native response, real transported query
aggregation: mean within each document, then equal weight document macro, stratum separated
heldout_scope: held out from this calibration only; all historical exploratory; PROJECT_INDEPENDENCE UNKNOWN
group_selection: Choose at most one of Asym128_FP16 and Asym64_FP16 using calibration H1 document macro only. Validation metrics for all conditions remain descriptive; no reselection. Fixed permutation may replace selection only by calibration objective if preregistered gate passes.
tile_selection: Only T2_FP16, with T0 and T1_FP16 as required comparators; ideal FP32 tile metadata is sensitivity, not deployment candidate.

promotion.positive_heldout_documents: more than half, minimum two; two requires two positive
promotion.baseline_scorer_radius: max observed absolute FP32-vs-FP64 baseline scoring difference x4, frozen separately by stratum before candidates; same sensitivity radius applied conservatively to both arms; not a certified candidate/forward error bound

permutation_gate.objective: H1 absolute squared native response document macro
permutation_gate.selection: strict calibration decrease; val evaluated once; no repeat search or horizon choice
